en: A black and white image showing a large, open cobblestone public square bordered by historic buildings, with a fountain at the center. In the background, a hillside dotted with trees rises above the town, and there is a prominent medieval-looking building or castle at the right. There are several people walking, and the scene appears old, likely early 20th century. Shop signs are visible on the facades. The text 'Ferdinand L...g' (likely Ferdinand Lengyel) can be read on one building, and there are other less readable signs.
